reply.text: {"options":[{"name":"Garlic Ginger Chicken Stir Fry","why":"Classic stir fry, fast and protein-forward","cuisine":"Chinese","method":"pan","minutes":25,"servings":2,"mealType":"dinner","ingredients":[{"text":"300 g chicken breast, sliced thin","quantity":300,"unit":"g","food":"chicken breast"},{"text":"200 g broccoli florets","quantity":200,"unit":"g","food":"broccoli florets"},{"text":"1 red bell pepper, sliced (about 120 g)","quantity":120,"unit":"g","food":"red bell pepper"},{"text":"1 carrot, sliced thin (about 80 g)","quantity":80,"unit":"g","food":"carrot"},{"text":"10 g fresh ginger, minced","quantity":10,"unit":"g","food":"fresh ginger"},{"text":"2 cloves garlic, minced (about 8 g)","quantity":8,"unit":"g","food":"garlic"},{"text":"15 g avocado oil","quantity":15,"unit":"g","food":"avocado oil"},{"text":"10 g honey","quantity":10,"unit":"g","food":"honey"},{"text":"15 g cider vinegar","quantity":15,"unit":"g","food":"cider vinegar"},{"text":"120 g long-grain white rice, dry","quantity":120,"unit":"g","food":"long-grain white rice"},{"text":"Salt and black pepper to taste","quantity":null,"unit":"","food":"salt"}],"steps":["Cook the rice according to the package directions and keep warm.","Toss the sliced chicken with a pinch of salt and pepper.","Heat the oil in a large pan or wok over high heat until shimmering.","Cook the chicken in a single layer, stirring now and then, until browned and cooked through to 165°F inside, about 5 to 6 minutes. Move to a plate.","Add the carrot, broccoli and pepper to the pan and stir fry 3 to 4 minutes until crisp-tender.","Add the ginger and garlic and stir for 30 seconds, then return the chicken.","Stir in the honey and vinegar, toss for a minute until glossy, and serve over the rice."]},{"name":"Beef and Green Bean Stir Fry","why":"Different protein, hearty and a bit spicy","cuisine":"Thai","method":"pot","minutes":25,"servings":2,"mealType":"dinner","ingredients":[{"text":"280 g sirloin steak, sliced thin against the grain","quantity":280,"unit":"g","food":"sirloin steak"},{"text":"200 g green beans, trimmed","quantity":200,"unit":"g","food":"green beans"},{"text":"1 onion, sliced (about 110 g)","quantity":110,"unit":"g","food":"onion"},{"text":"3 cloves garlic, minced (about 12 g)","quantity":12,"unit":"g","food":"garlic"},{"text":"15 g olive oil","quantity":15,"unit":"g","food":"olive oil"},{"text":"1 g chilli flakes","quantity":1,"unit":"g","food":"chilli flakes"},{"text":"10 g lemon juice","quantity":10,"unit":"g","food":"lemon juice"},{"text":"15 g honey","quantity":15,"unit":"g","food":"honey"},{"text":"100 g brown rice, dry","quantity":100,"unit":"g","food":"brown rice"},{"text":"Salt to taste","quantity":null,"unit":"","food":"salt"}],"steps":["Cook the rice in a pot according to the package directions.","Season the steak slices with salt.","Heat half the oil in a large pan over high heat and sear the steak in a single layer for 2 minutes until browned; whole cuts should reach 145°F, so cook a little longer if needed. Move to a plate.","Add the remaining oil, then the onion and green beans, and stir fry 4 to 5 minutes until the beans are blistered and tender-crisp.","Add the garlic and chilli flakes and stir for 30 seconds.","Return the beef, add the honey and lemon juice, and toss for 1 minute until coated.","Serve over the rice."]},{"name":"Veggie Egg Fried Rice Stir Fry","why":"Quickest one, no meat needed","cuisine":"Chinese","method":"air-fryer","minutes":20,"servings":2,"mealType":"lunch","ingredients":[{"text":"150 g long-grain white rice, dry (cooked and cooled)","quantity":150,"unit":"g","food":"long-grain white rice"},{"text":"3 large eggs","quantity":3,"unit":"large","food":"eggs"},{"text":"100 g carrot, diced small","quantity":100,"unit":"g","food":"carrot"},{"text":"100 g cabbage, shredded","quantity":100,"unit":"g","food":"cabbage"},{"text":"50 g mushrooms, sliced","quantity":50,"unit":"g","food":"mushrooms"},{"text":"2 cloves garlic, minced (about 8 g)","quantity":8,"unit":"g","food":"garlic"},{"text":"15 g avocado oil","quantity":15,"unit":"g","food":"avocado oil"},{"text":"5 g sesame seeds","quantity":5,"unit":"g","food":"sesame seeds"},{"text":"Salt and black pepper to taste","quantity":null,"unit":"","food":"salt"}],"steps":["Cook the rice ahead and let it cool; day-old rice fries best.","Toss the carrot, cabbage, mushrooms and garlic with the oil, salt and pepper.","Air fry the vegetables at 390°F for 8 minutes, shaking the basket halfway, until tender and lightly browned.","Beat the eggs and pour into a small oiled oven-safe dish; air fry at 350°F for 4 to 5 minutes until fully set with no runny egg, then chop.","Add the cooled rice to the basket with the vegetables and air fry 3 minutes more, shaking once, until hot throughout.","Fold in the chopped egg, season to taste, and finish with the sesame seeds."]}]}
